reason: The plugin is primarily an agent orchestration utility for DSH: it manages parallel, configurable shadow subagents and schedules their executions to augment the main agent with independent review/fact-check work, with user-facing slash commands and model tools for status, control, and configuration.

summaries.zh: dsh-shadow-mind 是一个 DSH 插件，用于在主代理旁并行运行 Shadow Mind 子代理，并在每次主轮次后按配置触发复核与事实核验流程，同时提供状态查看、控制与配置管理命令。
summaries.en: dsh-shadow-mind is a DSH plugin that runs parallel Shadow Mind subagents alongside the main agent, triggering review and fact-checking runs by heartbeat or command, with integrated status/control and configuration management.

capabilities: Runs multiple shadow subagents in parallel alongside the main agent
Provides model-tool management for creating/updating/deleting/running shadow definitions
Allows configuration changes via command/model tools with bounded execution via timeouts

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DSH plugin that runs multiple "Shadow Mind" agents beside the main agent and triggers random shadow activations after each main-agent turn.
README lists heartbeat scheduling, pause/resume, and auto on/off controls for parallel shadow runs.
README states shadows use configurable tool allowlists and exposes management tools such as create/update/delete/list shadows plus config read/write.
